# Contiki

> > Group travel tours and vacation packages for 18-35 year olds exploring Europe, USA, Australia, New Zealand, and beyond.

Contiki specializes in youth travel experiences with guided group tours across multiple continents. The company offers diverse travel styles from city breaks and winter tours to sustainable travel initiatives through their Make Travel Matter program.

## Key Topics

- Youth travel (18-35 years)
- Group tours and packages
- Europe destinations (Italy, France, Spain, Greece, Portugal)
- Multi-country tours
- 2025/2026 trip seasons
- Sustainable travel initiatives
- City breaks and cultural experiences
- Winter tours and Christmas markets
- USA and Canada adventures
- Australia and New Zealand tours
- Travel deals and combos
- Trip managers and tour guides
- Spring break packages
- Adventure and outdoor activities

## Popular Tours & Itineraries

- [London to Rome Quest](https://www.contiki.com/en-us/tours/london-to-rome-quest): 16-day London to Rome tour through France, Spain, and Italy
- [Barcelona to Rome Quest Tour](https://www.contiki.com/en-us/tours/barcelona-to-rome-quest): 9-day Barcelona to Rome tour with coastal vibes and architecture
- [Rome to London Trail Tour](https://www.contiki.com/en-us/tours/rome-to-london-trail): 8-day budget Europe tour: Rome, Paris, and Swiss Alps
